Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

For Q1, state what the evidence meant for Q2 forecast credit. For Q2, state what the day-7 result did and did not establish. Preserve the approved interpretation of the other three lanes in each package, and make the quarter-specific distinction clear rather than describing both exclusions as generic immaturity.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Helio Start exclusions — Q1 and Q2 2026 historical comparison", "body": "# Helio Start exclusions — Q1 and Q2 2026

*Historical comparison for new board-operations reviewers; records the approved quarter-specific interpretation, not a new claim decision.*

## Q1 2026 — mature organic evidence cleared a proposal gate, not a forecast gate

Helio Start was excluded from the approved Q1 operating-evidence section and remained **not board-ready** because the exact start and end dates for the two mature cohorts were missing. The evidence itself was not simply immature: two consecutive cohorts had complete day-90 outcomes, each had fewer than 5% of accounts above 90 support minutes (4/86, 4.7%; and 3/91, 3.3%), and neither admitted an unsupported case. Together they satisfied the evidence condition for **considering/preparing a capped paid-acquisition proposal**. They did **not** establish paid acquisition or its economics, and did **not** earn Q2 forecast or pipeline credit. Helio Start remained organic-only through March 31; separate budget approval and other authorization were still required. The missing cohort dates prevented board readiness despite the gate being met.

The other approved Q1 lanes retained their distinct limits:
- **Expansion Assist:** 18 actual exposures (Dec. 1–Jan. 30), all with complete 45-day windows; six help-or-options requests and four expansions. Descriptive only—no randomized control, causal, revenue, or forecast claim.
- **Pricing-page path quality:** Nov. 26–Feb. 28 post-rollout continuity: 143/1,981 eligibility-flow starts (7.2%) later routed out for an existing unsupported condition; 44.0% eligible-workspace admission completion; 75-minute account-level support-time 90th percentile. Not a new causal or revenue result.
- **CS auto-nudge system controls:** Jan. 1–Feb. 28 coverage of 2,146 decisions; 83 visible field-specific holds and 2,063 proceeded or were suppressed using current state. No governed-field disagreement, customer correction, or rollback; two source-age alerts fired before breach and sources refreshed in time. System-control performance only.

## Q2 2026 — a leading day-7 operating read was not a mature paid outcome

Helio Start was excluded from the approved Q2 section because its fixed 50-workspace paid-test cohort had not completed the required day-90 outcome window. **39 of 50 reached first integration by day 7**: this established only the predeclared leading operating result. It did not establish paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, mature account-level support effort, acquisition economics, scale, revenue, pipeline, or forecast credit. The approved Q2 decision kept the lane out pending complete day-90 outcomes; the paid-pilot outcome review remained open separately. This is distinct from Q1: Q1 had mature evidence sufficient to clear a proposal-consideration gate but failed a dates/readiness requirement; Q2 had a day-7 leading measure but lacked the mature outcomes needed for a paid-cohort claim.

The other approved Q2 lanes remained:
- **Expansion Assist:** 14 actual exposures (Feb. 1–Apr. 14), complete 45-day windows; five help-or-options requests and three expansions. Descriptive, with no causal, revenue, pipeline, or forecast treatment.
- **Pricing-page path quality:** Mar. 1–May 24 post-rollout continuity: 8,972 organic sessions; 1,844 eligibility-flow starts, with 132 (7.2%) later routed out for an existing unsupported condition; 44.2% eligible-workspace admission completion; 76-minute account-level support-time 90th percentile. Not a new causal result.
- **CS auto-nudge system controls:** Mar. 1–May 31 coverage of 3,418 unique decisions; 126 visible field-specific holds and 3,292 proceeded or were suppressed using current state. No governed-field disagreement, customer correction, or rollback; two source-age alerts resolved before breach.
